rows.text:
- The added browser seed failed before rendering: the current planning model rejects self-relations, including related edges. The review recommendation incorrectly assumed they were permitted.
- Preserve that validation and the existing reverse-relation browser checks; remove the invalid fixture seed.
- Cover valid self-edge deduplication through the generic engine/editor contract instead, then re-run the affected cases and checkpoint.
- The failing run is retained. No product rule will be weakened to make this fixture pass.
